title: Functional genomic landscape of cancer-intrinsic evasion of killing by T cells
reading_scope: Prior-art executor targeted Methods/Results; data executor inspected official GEO count/library rows and joined GEO SOFT sample titles
measured_outcomes: Raw guide-selection read counts; no direct percent killing; published differential-fitness screens
already_reported: Six mouse tumor lines, paired CTL/control screens and a 182-gene cross-line core are already reported; secondary focused validation across same six lines is published
remaining_question: Whether a specific noncanonical perturbation has a distinct functional pattern in an independent CAR-T setting remains unresolved
limitations: Data executor did not inspect the large publisher supplement archive; six line models are inference units, not guide rows; mapped sample file omits 18 of 115 count columns

title: GSE149933: cancer-intrinsic T-cell killing CRISPR screens
reading_scope: Official GEO record, processed count/library tables and family SOFT sample metadata; actual rows/schema inspected
measured_outcomes: 94,528 guide rows x 115 raw read-count columns; 94,528-row guide annotation; 175 GEO sample records; 97 count columns mapped to sample titles
already_reported: Series supports the Lawson CTL-vs-control screens; its paper already reported generic cross-line sensitization
remaining_question: Can supply six line-specific CTL/control screen rows for a fixed cross-study question, subject to non-fit and selection limits
limitations: 18 count columns lack a mapped sample in this SOFT file; counts are selection read counts, not gene-level effect estimates or lysis; Renca-HA CTL and antigen-free Renca cytokine arms must not be pooled

title: Leukemia-intrinsic determinants of CAR-T response revealed by iterative in vivo genome-wide CRISPR screening
reading_scope: Prior-art executor targeted Methods/Results; official publisher SupplementaryData1 workbook rows/headers inspected
measured_outcomes: Selected validation-panel gene-level MAGeCK LFC/FDR from guide selection, not direct percent killing
already_reported: Study already directly tested in-vitro versus immunocompetent in-vivo context, including opposite IFNγR/JAK/STAT effects; tissue/NK-related effects are published
remaining_question: An exact noncanonical mechanism-specific transfer effect remains unresolved; a generic concordance map is not a distinct contribution
limitations: One syngeneic murine B-ALL model; 1,021 genes are selected validation entries, not independent biological units; some in-vivo workbook headers appear dose-mismatched

title: Targeting autophagy overcomes cancer-intrinsic resistance to CAR-T immunotherapy in B-cell malignancies
reading_scope: Prior-art executor targeted Methods/Results; no outcome file downloaded by data executor
measured_outcomes: CAR-T selection screen plus genetic/pharmacologic validations; primary outcomes are described in sibling prior-art record
already_reported: Autophagy inhibition and broad B-cell CAR-T sensitization already published
remaining_question: No autophagy or generic B-cell CAR-T sensitization claim remains open for this candidate
limitations: Discovery screen is one human B-ALL line; independent discovery-screen replicate count was unclear in inspected text; clinical association is small and retrospective
